# Registry attributes (generated)

Part of [flags.md §13](../flags.md#13-mutable-flag-registry): the rows of `services/flag-service/registry.yaml` that carry each attribute. The flag service reads the attributes; the rules they must keep are in flags.md §13.

## Kill switches

`kill_switch: true` ([flags.md §13.6](../flags.md#136-flagsmith-link-implemented-2588-to-2592-uc-054-uc-055)): applied first in a Flagsmith round; with persist, applied even when the save fails.

| `agent/decision.claude.max_requests_per_minute` | no |  |
| `agent/enabled` | no | `off` |
| `agent/experiment_proposer_enabled` | no |  |
| `agent/experiments_enabled` | no |  |
| `agent/interventions_allowed` | yes |  |
| `agent/llm.max_requests_per_minute` | no |  |

## Flagsmith only

`flagsmith_only: true`: written only by the Flagsmith link, `403 flagsmith_only` over HTTP.

- `agent/goal.profile`
